name: Darion
about: Darion (class 1029), the Tenebrae soldier who trains fighters. With Leveling on (game/stat_growth.h) his paid training raises STR or DEX by one a session, for the Avatar or a companion walking with him; the lines and prices are in data/stat_growth.json. His original 'I need training.' sparring session gives nothing with Leveling on (specs/world/leveling_facts.md 4), so it is taken out of his menu then and ours, in the same words, takes its place. With Leveling off his menu is the original's. INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: Whom does the guard protect if the Tempest is unjust?
say: Hah! That is a question for a philosopher, not a soldier. I serve the Tempestry, friend. The Tempest holds Hydros' power. That is the law.
A guard who picks and chooses his orders is no guard at all. He's a mob with a nice helmet.
...But I'll tell you this, and only once. A man can keep his oath and still keep his eyes open.
Now. Official policy and all. We never spoke of it.
